profile.headline: Software Engineer at Pacific Northwest National Laboratory

positions.title: Oracle Database and Application Administrator
positions.description:
Upgrade, patch and maintain Oracle eBusiness Suite Release 11 and Release 12 for 16 environments
Document existing and new procedures for request fulfillment, environment cloning, and code migration
Administer  Oracle Internet Directory and Oracle Access Manager as a Single-Sign-On solution for Oracle eBusiness Suite
Support 24-7 service availability with admin on-call rotation
Impose complex change control requirements to allow management team review
Diagnose connection or speed issues with data access and implement corrections

positions.title: Intern, Safeguards & Security Technology
positions.description:
Design algorithms to analyze large, scientific data sets and visualization tools to evaluate their effectiveness.
Develop methods for real-time process monitoring and implement as a Windows Service.
Build coordinated applications for desktop and Pocket PC to track high value assets in unmonitored areas.

Graduate Teaching Assistant in Computer Science.
